questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

42 + 14 ÷ 28 × 98 - 14 = 105
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 42 + 14 ÷ 28 × 98 - 14 = 105

(1) **÷ and -**

⇒ 42 + 14 ÷ 28 × 98 - 14 = 105

After changing the signs:

⇒ 42 + 14 - 28 × __**98 ÷ 14**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 42 + 14 - __**28 × 7**__

⇒ 42 + 14 - 196

⇒ (-140)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **- and +**

⇒ 42 + 14 ÷ 28 × 98 - 14 = 105

After changing the signs:

⇒ 42 - __**14 ÷ 28**__ × 98 + 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 42 - __**0.5 × 98**__ + 14

⇒ 42 - 49 + 14

⇒ 56 - 49 = 7

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) **× and ÷**

⇒ 42 + 14 ÷ 28 × 98 - 14 = 105

After changing the signs:

⇒ 42 + 14 × __**28 ÷ 98**__ - 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 42 + __**14 × 0.2857**__ - 14

⇒ 42 + 4 - 14

⇒ 46 - 14 = 32

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) **+ and ×**

⇒ 42 + 14 ÷ 28 × 98 - 14 = 105

After changing the signs:

⇒ 42 × 14 ÷ 28 + 98 - 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**42 × 0.5**__ + 98 - 14

⇒ 21 + 98 - 14

⇒ 119 - 14 = 105

⇒** '****42 × 14 ÷ 28 + 98 - 14 = 105'**

Here, the equation is** satisfied.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".

questions.question: As per November 2022, who is the Chief Economic Advisor of India?

• He will succeed Justice N V Ramana, who will retire on **26 August 2022.**
 
• Justice Lalit was appointed a judge of the Supreme Court in 2014.
 
• He will become the second CJI to be directly elevated to the Supreme Court from the Bar, after Justice S.M. Sikri, who served as the 13th CJI in 1971.

• India is a federal State and has a single and unified judicial system with a three-tier structure.
 
• The Indian constitution provides for a provision of the Supreme Court under Part V (The Union) and Chapter 6 (The Union Judiciary).
 
• Articles 124 to 147 in Part V of the Constitution deal with the organisation, independence, jurisdiction, powers and procedures of the Supreme Court.
 
• The promulgation of Regulating Act of 1773 established the Supreme Court of Judicature at Calcutta as a Court of Record, with full power & authority.
 
• It was established to hear and determine all complaints for any crimes and also to entertain, hear and determine any suits or actions in Bengal, Bihar and Orissa.
 
• The Supreme Courts at Madras and Bombay were established by King George – III in 1800 and 1823 respectively.

questions.question: A sum of money doubles itself at compound interest in 10 years. In how many years will it be four times at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In Compound Interest, if a sum becomes 'n' times in 'T' years, it becomes 'nk' times in 'k × T' years.

Here, the sum doubles (2 times) in 10 years (n = 2, T = 10).

To become four times (4 = 2²), the power k = 2.

Time required = k × T = 2 × 10 = 20 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Sum = P

Amount after 10 years = 2P

Target Amount = 4P

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e36ae2a959de069380b62e30ec5538143e6b211b4a1e20a7f6b60d6ddc39ece2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2P = P(1 + r/100)¹⁰

⇒ 2 = (1 + r/100)¹⁰ ---- (i)

⇒ Let the required time be 't' years for the sum to become 4P.

⇒ 4P = P(1 + r/100)t

⇒ 4 = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ (2)² = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ Substituting value of 2 from (i):

⇒ [(1 + r/100)¹⁰]² = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ (1 + r/100)²⁰ = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ By comparing powers, t = 20 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Interest

When interest is compounded more than once a year, the effective annual rate is (1 + r/n)ⁿ − 1, where n is the frequency of compounding.

Rule of 72

A quick way to estimate how long it takes to double money at CI: Time ≈ 72 ÷ Interest Rate.

SI vs CI for Doubling

In Simple Interest, if a sum doubles in T years, it becomes n times in (n−1) × T years. For 4 times, it would take (4−1) × 10 = 30 years.</p

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days, and B and C together can do the same work in 100 days. If B alone can do the same work in 140 days, then in how many days will A and C together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

A and B can do a piece of work in 20 days.

B and C can do the same work in 100 days.

B alone can do the same work in 140 days.

**Concept:**

Work done = Efficiency × Number of Days

**Solution:**

⇒ Work done by (A + B) in a day = 1/20.

⇒ Work done by (B + C) in a day = 1/100.

⇒ Work done by B in a day = 1/140.

⇒ Work done by A in a day = (A + B) - B = 1/20 - 1/140 = 6/140 = 3/70.

⇒ Work done by C in a day = (B + C) - B = 1/100 - 1/140 = 2/700 = 1/350.

⇒ Therefore, A and C together can do the work in 1/(A + C) = 1/(3/70 + 1/350) = 1/(4/70) = 175/8 days.

**Therefore, A and C together can complete the same work in 175/8 days.**
